args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring already specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
per FIN-212, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212) in its docstring but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, failing the nightly build in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` must round to `2.66`).
- Fixed by using `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed.
